trap.wrong: Never they had seen such a view.

trap.why: O português mantém sujeito + verbo depois de “nunca”. Em inglês formal, advérbio negativo no início exige auxiliar antes do sujeito.

mcq.why: Rarely do talks fail: auxiliar antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: Under no circumstances ___ share the password.

mcq.why: Com does, o verbo fica na base.

fix.wrong: Never I have felt so tired.
fix.right: Never have I felt so tired.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Never: “They had never seen such a rise.”
rewrite.answer: Never had they seen such a rise.
